params.body:
Frederik sent a Word document on 2026-09-15, "Ontbrekende vertalingen naar Frans": per screen the Dutch his French-speaking dealers still read with the app in French, and the French he wants there. This PR sets every line of it, and makes the bidding detail speak French entirely.

## What changed for a French user

**Own-stock row**: `pa € 8 000` (purchase price, was `in €`), `Publier sur Stocklist`, badge `Sur Stocklist`, `Demander le Car-Pass` (was "Demander Car-Pass"), Car-Pass link title `Consulter le Car-Pass`, and the Actions menu: `Mettre en option`, `Proposer à un client`, `Retirer du stock`, `Annuler le contrôle technique`, `Retirer de Stocklist`, `Imprimer l'affiche du showroom`, `Marquer comme vendu`. The other literals in the same row went along (`Mettre en stock`, `Prêt pour le contrôle technique`, `Brouillon`, `Pas de Car-Pass`, `Retirer l'option`, `Compléter la fiche`, the "registering..." state of the Car-Pass chip) and, from Shane's screenshot, the portals panel: `Portails`, `Publier sur les portails`, `Modifier les portails`, `Aucun portail`, the locked-switch hint.

**Vehicle sheet**: top-right button `Afficher` (it read the missing key `global.bekijken` and fell back to "Bekijken"; now `ui.bekijken`, whose French is `Afficher`), `est défini lors de la création` on the Type step, `Sur Stocklist` in the status bar, the Preview button and its tooltip.

**Stocklist detail**: `Marquer comme favori` / `Favori` (plus the titles), Car-Pass `Consulter`, `Proposer à un client`, `Différence entre les formules` (the key `warranty.difference_pdf` had no French and showed raw on screen), and the specification grid, which was Dutch literals: Kilométrage, Première immatriculation, État, Catégorie, Carrosserie, Transmission, Carburant, Peinture, Couleur, Cylindrée, Puissance, Puissance (kW), with `ch` instead of `pk` and `hors TVA` instead of "excl. BTW" on the transport line.

**Bidding**: menu `Offres d'enchères` / `Tout ce sur quoi on peut enchérir`; detail heading `Offres d'enchères`, `Faites une offre`, `Jusqu'au dd/mm/yyyy` / `Terminée le`, `Montant en €`, the confirmation before a bid and the "bid placed" message. Formal French in the client's tone for the lines the document left blank.

One root-cause fix beyond wording: the bidding detail link rendered in the default language on the **first** visit and only in the bidder's language on the next, because `SetLangMiddleware` read the session before `ExportController::detail` wrote the bidder's language into it. The controller now sets the locale for the current request too (unless the viewer picked a language).

## How

Every literal became a key in `resources/lang/{nl,fr,en,de}/{ownstock,stocklist,bidding}.php` (en/de translated sensibly); the French is the client's wording verbatim. Two deviations, both the brand only: "Sur stockist" is `Sur Stocklist`, and "Retirer de stocklist" is `Retirer de Stocklist`. Confirmation texts moved to `data-confirm` attributes so an apostrophe in a translation cannot end the Alpine expression.

## Tests

`FrenchTranslationsTest` renders the own-stock row (published with Car-Pass, and unpublished), the Stocklist detail as a French user and the bidding detail for a French bidder on its first visit, asserts the French above and that none of the Dutch originals remain, and checks statically that every key used in those views exists in `fr`. Rule `R P2-2.9` added; finding `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-15-franse-vertalingen-frederik.md` (opgelost, beslist: Frederik).

Filter run locally: `Translation|Lang|OwnStockRowMarkup|Bidding|Stocklist|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity|CompiledViews|AlpineExpression|HandlerWiring|StylesheetSyntax|VehicleSheetHeader`: plus `Proposal`: 157 tests, 1539 assertions, green (rebased on main with the relation_proposals flag; the propose label is asserted with the flag on).

## Seen, handled elsewhere (other PRs today)

- the "mark as sold" pop-up layout with the invisible Cancel button
- the damage plan on the Dommages tab
- the offer that cannot be made because the relation is not saved
- "Suppléments" showing `Order.add_extra`

## Open

- "(enkel BTW-voertuigen)" after Flexlease/goforlease in the portals panel is not code: it is the portal's `name_nl` in the `portals` table, and an empty `name_fr` falls back to Dutch. Fill `name_fr`/`name_en`/`name_de` on those rows.
- `resources/views/website/*` (the dealer's public site) still has `pk` and Dutch spec labels; not in the client's list, untouched.
params.title: French strings the client listed, and the bidding detail speaks French
